thread:
emma: Quick check-in: I'm proposing a "launchboard" for the Console observability v1. Goal: unambiguous acceptance and a single source-of-truth for handoff. Minimal deliverables: 3 dashboards, one lightweight trace hook, cost attribution by model+route, and an error triage runbook.

raj: Sounds good. Can we make the dashboards templated so customers can filter by project/model quickly?

emma: Yes. Template requirements: filters for model, route, timeframe; a per-1k-req cost toggle; and a CSV export.

thom: For tracing: prefer sampling in the edge with these rules: baseline 0.25%, force-sample on error, and a per-customer opt-in for full traces. Implementation note: do sample decision in nginx lua to avoid runtime overhead.

raj: Agree on edge sampling. We should also emit a small token-estimate metric so cost dashboard doesn't rely on full token accounting for launch. Metric name proposal: `redwood.estimate.tokens` and tag `redwood.model.name`.

nina: Data infra: we'll pre-aggregate hourly and keep 30d retention for v1. We'll also provide a billing-sandbox reconciliation job. Acceptance: model buckets must be within 12% of sandbox billing.

thom: Perf guardrails: trace.enabled on canary must not increase p99 by >3ms. Plan is async defers + batched trace writes with max_delay=150ms. Example config: `tracing.async_flush_ms=150`, `tracing.sample_pct=0.25`.

emma: Runbook outline: steps to triage an error spike -> quick drill to traces -> mitigation knobs (cache, smaller model, enable route-caching). We'll link it from alerts.

raj: Alerts: cost-growth (>20% week-over-week) and error-rate by route (>x% in 5m). Alerts must include the playbook link and suggested mitigations.

billing-bot: FYI: billing sandbox available 2026-05-20; create a sandbox tenant and tag `observe-v1` for tests.

ops-bot: Candidate canary slot: 2026-05-21 23:00-01:00 UTC; rollout 2026-05-22 02:00-05:00 UTC.

nina: Action items: Data to deliver QA dataset by Wed, recon job by Fri.

thom: Eng spikes: nginx sampling hook + async flush impl in runtime. ETA: 6bd for spike + PRs. I'll scope websockets out of v1 to save time.

emma: Product to publish launchboard checklist + customer-facing doc by Fri EOD. I'll coordinate the RFC with metric names.

raj: I'll post the RFC with metric names, sample algorithm, and dashboard templates by Thu.

emma: If we hit the dates we target the ops windows. Quick reactions: :white_check_mark: :rocket: 

raj: :white_check_mark:

thom: :rocket:

nina: :eyes:

ops-bot: Canary + rollout slots reserved.
